Ten persons, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W, X and Y, sit around a circular table, not necessarily in the same order. Some of them face the centre while the others face outside (away from the centre). Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. The one who sits second to the right of X faces outside.
2. The one who sits to the immediate left of Q faces outside.
3. The immediate neighbours of T face opposite directions.

7. Neither U nor S is an immediate neighbour of X.
8. Q sits to the immediate right of Y.
9. Y sits second to the right of the one who sits to the immediate right of S.
10. Q sits exactly opposite W.
11. V sits to the immediate left of the one who sits exactly opposite R.
12. T sits third to the left of W, who faces outside.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Circular seating (mixed facing)
set.stimulus:
Eight persons, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R and S, sit around a circular table, not necessarily in the same order. Some of them face the centre while the others face outside (away from the centre). Each of them likes a different colour: Green, Grey, Pink, Purple, Red, Violet, White and Yellow. Left and right are taken from each person's own point of view.

1. The one who likes Red sits exactly opposite the one who likes Violet.
2. Only one person sits between the one who likes Pink and S.
3. K sits second to the left of the one who sits exactly opposite S.
4. N sits third to the left of the one who likes Yellow.
5. The one who likes Green and the one who likes Grey face opposite directions.
6. N sits third to the left of the one who likes Violet.
7. The one who likes Grey sits to the immediate right of the one who likes White.
8. Only two persons sit between L and R when counted from the right of L.
9. The one who likes Pink is an immediate neighbour of the one who likes Grey.
10. The one who likes Violet sits to the immediate left of S.
11. K sits second to the left of N, who faces the centre.
12. Neither R nor K is an immediate neighbour of N.
13. The one who sits to the immediate right of P faces outside.
14. Q sits third to the left of N.
